instrument: Texas SB 6, Util. Code 39.169 (co-location with existing generation)
summary: Net metering between an existing stand-alone generator and a new large load requires notice to ERCOT, an ERCOT study within 120 days of complete information, and a PUC decision within 60 days of the study; if the PUC does not act by the deadline the arrangement is considered approved. Decisions are posted on the PUC website.

source.citation: Texas SB 6 (89th Leg., enrolled; effective June 20, 2025), LegiScan mirror
